name: WittyIntegratedFileBrowser
summary: Choosing a server's folders from any device. Read-only.
updates: Finding drives and usual folders, listing what is in a folder, the folder window in the web app, and the Server folders page every app draws, a TV's included.
stays: The server's folder route (GET /api/fs), its checks of what this module answers, naming what kind of media each file is, the folders already in your libraries, and typing a folder's path when this module isn't there.
